ledger.x: 1260: Cliopatria's County of Holland begins as Holland, Zeeland and West Friesland.
1299: the counts of Hainaut become counts of Holland.
1299: Hainaut joins Holland and Zeeland in a personal union ('Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland: 1299-1356').
1433: the County of Holland ends as a map state.

wars.name: Hook and Cod Wars
wars.outcome: 'The Hook and Cod Wars were a series of wars and battles in Holland between 1350 and 1490'; 'By the end of the Hook and Cod Wars, Philip the Good, Duke of Burgundy, had taken control of Holland.'
